title: Open Label Study of Zonisamide in the Treatment of Epilepsy in Patients With Mental Retardation
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the efficacy and tolerability in "real-world" clinical practice, of adjunctive zonisamide treatment in adult patients with developmental disabilities and epilepsy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or Female, at least 18 years of age
* Diagnosis of mental retardation
* Uncontrolled seizures or intolerable side effects from current AEDs
* Legal guardian is able to consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Sulfa allergy
* Prior exposure to zonisamide
